notes.title: Tempo Level Editor Access
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, this is a special update for all our Dancers out there! ːsteamhappyː

Tempo has been live and playable for 4 years this November! After all this, we couldn't be more excited to share our latest update.  We present to you, the **TEMPO, Level Editor!!!**

[h2][u]The Level Editor[/u][/h2]
This update actually has even more great things, but to start us off, the Tempo Level Editor is now publicly accessible and allows you (and other players around the world) to create and play non-developer-made Tempo levels. We created a short [url=https://youtu.be/fsbl5THrkUQ]video tutorial[/url] and some [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nb2H_LD2clLftfXbicSavPECBDld40SY/view?usp=sharing]documentation[/url] but the whole process has been designed to let you craft and try new levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/f617309187bab61ec4d123f88ad44a7c02c5151c.jpg[/img]
([i]now when you click the level editor button, you will be presented with new options[/i])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/8b5c0e0b1f60f1be91afd1d0ae6ff7e0195318cd.png[/img]
([i]this is a concept that pretty closely matches the final results[/i])

If you'd like to share and try other people's levels, consider [url=https://discord.com/invite/BbZ3K9YSkp]joining our Discord[/url] where we've just opened up a community channel for this exact update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/e22ef7972e9e13af3c420ab9ecfec84e689507fc.gif[/img] ([i]This is what the level editor looked like for us developers, before we worked to make it public[/i])

[h2][u]Other Updates[/u][/h2]
- Tempo is now available on Mac & Linux (Woo!)

- Tempo always recorded stats like scores and time, but now it tracks that data and let's you see it at the end of any level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/180ad1e1ff13c0b4a19b6e4d3b6901e8b2eef75a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/b988f97a27170178cc79181398db9d4fecca7e7e.jpg[/img]

- Custom Levels have been given their own leaderboards (which may be reset when we reset all non-custom leaderboards)


[h2][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h2]
- Tempo will no longer crash / freeze if you try to play a level without being connected to steam
- A bunch of refactoring and code cleanup has been done to make the level editor possible for the public
- Small general refactors and optimizations have been made to hopefully speed up and improve the game.

[previewyoutube=fsbl5THrkUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][u]Final Notes[/u][/h2]
We will be listening for any issues or feedback as always, but we hope you enjoy Tempo and all of the free updates we've been able to provide to make the game an even better experience!

ːsteamthisː (Enjoying the updates? Leave us a Steam Review!) ːsteamthisː

notes.title: New Year 2025 Score Wipe
notes.content:
Hello Tempo Community! ːsteamhappyː

Happy New Year to everyone we hope you are well and healthy with a new year of engaging new experiences ahead of you!

A small update that we've reset ALL the Tempo Leaderboards as of today! Around 100,000 score entries from you ːsteamthumbsupː wonderful people. As a fun side note, the level with the MOST unique player entries was
[spoiler]Tutorial 3 - Stick Around[/spoiler] at [spoiler]30,520[/spoiler] Score Entries

We also set the achievements back to their originally designed goals. Congratulations to everyone who was able to complete all of the Tempo achievements during this time, and we're excited to see everyone stepping up to the challenge ːsteammockingː

Lastly, without giving too many details, we've got another update planned in the near future that we believe some people will love. But until then, we're always here and want to thank you again for being an amazing part of our community 

Thank you!
- Aestronauts Dev Team

notes.title: Tempo Score Wipe
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː[b]Hello Awesome Tempo Community![/b]ːsteammockingː


We are sharing this announcement to cover the following topics
[list]
[*] Limited Time Tempo Achievement Changes
[*] Upcoming Score Resets
[*] What Aestroanuts is working on in the meantime
[/list]


[h2]Limited Time Tempo Achievement Changes[/h2] (RIGHT NOW)

In our last update on April 29th 2024 we did an update to the game that introduced many elements the most noteworthy being;
[list]
[*] 1 New world "Spirit Crossing"
[*] 5 New Levels (each with their own custom soundtrack)
[*] New home screen UI to improve user experience and tracking high-scores
[*] Character Customization and Unlocking
[*] 35 Carefully designed and custom art'd Achievements
[/list]

We realize that some of our achievements were asking a lot from players (like having players run over 1 million tiles). While this is very reasonable to achieve on a casual or hardcore schedule, we'd like to offer the community a limited-time December 2024 gift by making several achievements [b]GREATLY[/b] reduced asks. This is in honor of our players who have been playing and apart of the community since 2021. During this time, achievements have a much lower threshold to achieve (ex. instead of 1-million tiles the number is 1000). In January 2025 these thresholds will return to normal (1-million tiles achievement will once again require 1-million tiles total).


[b]Upcoming Score Resets[/b]

We feel it would be best to provide new opportunities for players to shine. While we mostly abstained from resetting or removing genuinely achieved scores, we always want to support you (our community). With the latest achievements and home-screen updates, we want players to feel invited to challenge themselves and improve so we'll be wiping the scores for every level in January 2025. 

As a team, we're still discussing how often we should reset scores, but at a minimum, we have resolutely agreed upon once a year, and this coming year 2025 will be our first wipe since releasing the game!


[b]What Aestroanuts Is Working On In The Meantime[/b]

Since we began in 2021, we have developed and built nearly a hundred different prototypes and ideas. As a team, we're always focused on growing our skills and putting interesting qualities above "success" or quantity. 

That being said, we do want to deliver an experience that is loved and playable and helps support us financially to create more. While it's not yet clearly defined exactly what that looks like, we are happily making progress on a new project that is anticipated to do the following;
[list]
[*] test the player's intellect and logic skills
[*] have visuals and audio that's interesting
[*] support learning and mastery
[*] allow players to create and share custom content
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/82136681bc77b7599b4059734301e3e5370158a9.gif[/img]

These are not far off from the goals we had for Tempo, but we've learned quite a bit since then and we feel closer than ever to achieving these. Most importantly, thank you to everyone who has been with us along the way, You Rock!

notes.title: Tempo Spirit Update
notes.content:
Dancers!

You may have noticed Musa has been quiet for a little while since sharing her last Tempo updates, but we're excited to announce she's back and she's brought some new friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/79dffab30167d7260996b7fbced74df735b10f65.png[/img]

Check out the trailer
[previewyoutube=8a50THGSc54;full][/previewyoutube]

In this Tempo update we're bringing you:
 + A brand new environment "Spirit Crosser"
 + 5 unique levels for the new world
 + 5 unique custom-composed thematic tracks for the New World
 + Adding 35 Steam Achievements to be unlocked
 + Character customization options that allow you to change your Musa, with certain cosmetics available after completing achievements
 + 4+ customizations for each Musa feature, that's over 20 new unlocks and 70+ possible combinations!
 + Updated home screen leaderboard UI to display your Top 5 Ranks once you've completed at least 5 levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859974/81543d5a917ee2bec8ca5a28aaf0598a5180adb6.png[/img]

We really hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed working on everything, and we look forward to hearing your feedback!

- Tempo Dev Team

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch - November 12, 2021
notes.content:
[b]- Quality of Life Patch - [/b]
- Custom key rebinds
- Buffered input to aid in speedrunning
- Display both your new BPM and Personal Record in Leaderboard UI
- Improved visibility
  - Improved trap tile colors
  - Improved contrast in Floating Atlantis and Heaven's Door
  - Camera angle
  - Improved HUD position
- Twin Stick support for Controllers
- Music Playlist for MainMenu
- Removed Discord noises from MainMenu Theme
- Increased Credits scroll speed
- Updated 'Next' to say 'Menu' when it will bring you to the MainMenu
- Improved SettingsMenu readability

[b]- Bug Fixes -[/b]
- Fixed audio slider resetting on reload
- Fixed In-Game Menu spelling errors
- Disabled linewrapping in LeaderBoard UI
- Fixed Histogram plots on displaying top 100 scores instead of uniform distribution
- Fixed game crash on loading invalid files through AudioPlayer
- Removed ability to open a level dozens of times through spam clicking
